reuse.why: Adds a new category_groups.notes column via migration instead of using the existing notes table where group notes live, ignores shared/tags extractTagsFromText, and setMonthAvg re-implements setNMonthAvg's per-category average logic instead of calling it.

duplication.why: The #fixed and saved-template conditions are written in the visibleUntemplatedCategory fragment, again in getVisibleUntemplatedCategories' WHERE, again as a CASE in getBudgetData, and once more in JS in copyPreviousMonth.

placement.why: A schema migration and API model change are added for a budget-action rule, and the eligibility rule is split between SQL helpers and inline JS in copyPreviousMonth.

scope.why: Introduces a database migration, new DB/entity/API fields and restructures the average actions beyond what the requests need.

maintainability.why: Redundant overlapping filters, a parallel notes store and a copy of the eligibility rule in copyPreviousMonth make the rule hard to change consistently.

bypasses_abstraction.where: new category_groups.notes column bypasses the notes table and tag parser; copyPreviousMonth re-decides eligibility in JS instead of using getVisibleUntemplatedCategories; setMonthAvg bypasses setNMonthAvg

disguised_duplication.where: the #fixed/saved-template rule appears as a SQL fragment constant, an inline WHERE, a CASE column and a JS condition; setMonthAvg reshapes setNMonthAvg's average-and-sign logic

abstraction_drift.where: getVisibleUntemplatedCategories takes includeHiddenCategories and switches between two filter strings; copyPreviousMonth applies its own JS version of the eligibility rule with the hidden flag
